resources.string: Own mail server

For a mail server of your own. Its settings are read only from your domain: its SRV records, then its usual host names (mail., imap., smtp.). Your address is not sent to Mozilla, Microsoft or any other directory. An untrusted certificate is shown for you to check before anything is saved.
I2P mail (mail.i2p)

Anonymous mail with Postman over the I2P network, through an I2P router on a server of your own (a VPS, a Raspberry Pi): the phone runs none. Set the server up with i2p-server/setup.sh; a new mailbox is created there with i2p-server/register.py.

The phone connects over TLS to ports 7669 (SMTP) and 7670 (POP3) of your server. A mailbox set up before over the router once built into this app is moved over, with its messages.

Synchronize only while the device is unlocked
Saves battery: locking the device stops synchronizing and ends the background service, unlocking checks for new messages at once. No new message notifications arrive while locked.
